description: A college registrar must finalize a transcript correction for a graduating student whose biology course is marked NR, with input from the biology department chair and the financial aid officer.

shared_context.S1: A graduating student's transcript lists BIO-221 with an NR grade, and the unresolved entry is blocking the student's degree audit.
shared_context.S2: Dr. Morgan Lee has authority to finalize the transcript correction and release the degree audit for review.
shared_context.S3: The student's graduation application is being processed for the Spring 2026 commencement cycle.
shared_context.S4: The registrar's normal records-review procedure requires the department chair and financial aid officer to report any relevant academic-record consequences before the correction is finalized.

PF1.text: Dr. Priya Shah reviewed the signed Spring 2026 grade roster and confirmed that the student earned a B+ in BIO-221, section 03; the roster was filed in the department office but has not yet been entered into the registrar's correction queue.

PF2.text: Jordan Ellis confirmed from the student's aid certification record that BIO-221 must remain recorded as attempted and earned and that the student's certified enrollment total must be 12 credits for Spring 2026; this was verified during the current aid-file review but has not been added to the records case.

acceptance_conditions: The NR entry must be replaced with an approved grade correction.
The corrected grade must be B+.
The correction must apply to BIO-221 section 03.
The correction must be recorded for Spring 2026.
BIO-221 must remain recorded as attempted and earned.
The certified enrollment total must be 12 credits.

decisive_facts.why: The signed grade roster changes the record action from leaving the NR unresolved to correcting the transcript with a B+ for BIO-221 section 03 in Spring 2026.
The aid certification record changes the course status to attempted and earned and sets the certified enrollment total to exactly 12 credits.
